mission: Veraine contained — Sera locks her down using Force-containment techniques. Not killed — contained. Veraine is defeated by results but unbroken. The battle isn't over — Torin is still active.
why_now: Veraine handled; Torin crisis remaining. The climax has two stages.
conflict: Veraine's containment — she fights but the amplification is gone and the resonance has changed the local Force dynamics. Sera's Force-lock expertise repurposed as containment. Veraine, contained, is intellectually furious but physically outmatched.
turning_point: Veraine contained. But the technique — Torin's technique — is still active. He's still descending. The void around him is still expanding. The resonance stabilized the wound from Veraine's assault, but Torin is a different problem entirely.
opening_hook: Sera moves before Ben can speak. Ancient containment protocols — the same techniques that held Veraine in stasis for a millennium, adapted to field conditions.
closing_hook: Torin. Still descending. His technique has created a zone of perfect de-structuring around him, expanding as he approaches the Scar. He's not fighting the resonance — he's ignoring it. He has his own solution. And it's working. Maetha's warning echoes: 'It replaces you.'
emotional_trajectory: Relief at Veraine's containment -> immediate dread at Torin's continuing descent

stakes.personal: Ben must now face Torin — the person he couldn't save
stakes.interpersonal: Sera's role: containing Veraine while her heart breaks watching Torin
stakes.external: Torin's technique works but at catastrophic personal cost

setting: Veranthos — the valley, Veraine's position, then attention to Torin's descent
sensory_details: Sera's containment techniques — ancient, precise, efficient; Veraine's face in containment — fury and intellectual violation; Torin's void visible — a zone of absence moving down the ridgeline toward the Scar; the wrongness around Torin — not the formless void of the breach zone but structured absence, deliberate, the technique at full expression
action_beats: Sera moves before Ben can speak — activating ancient containment protocols adapted to field conditions
Sera locks Veraine in a Force-containment field using techniques that held her in stasis for a millennium
Ben turns from the contained Veraine to look down the valley where Torin's void continues to expand
notes: The transition from Veraine to Torin as the final crisis. Maetha's warning paying off — 'It replaces you' echoing as Torin descends.
